- START (Calculate postings, calculate(bag) lines 78-90, called at line 143 with input): bag.dailyTransactions, accounts, cardXrefs, categoryBalances = decoded records with the contract field names (the adapter's encode body, no renaming); processedTimestamp optional, left unset (runtime UTC).
- END: Package results (line 171) writes output={result:{posttranTransact, posttranDalyrejs, posttranAcctdata, posttranTcatbal, summary, assumptionEntries, assumptionsMarkdown, ...}}; the decoder's own 'result' unwrapping, then names renamed (no _root)
- MODE records (run with MODE=records; no map.json)
- Register: evidence entries A01-A15 at lines 46-60 (one per line)
build: A01 lookup order conflicts with the invalid-card/expired-account example
A02 sequence allocation (pp.9,23) vs BR09 transactionId; incoming numbers kept, a departure from the sequence wording
A06 extracting the ISO date from the timestamp not specified
A08 repeated feed rows, winning occurrence and duplicate reason not defined
A11 pure-calculation errors and their return code not defined
A14 category-balance cat_cd type not specified; kept as four-character text
cr_rule: code lines 91-92: feed sorted by amount in cents ascending, ties by feed index (stable), unreadable amounts last, before any check or posting (line 93). No register entry mentions posting order (CR flag: no). Over-limit: credit - debit + amount with stored signs (line 100, no sign change). Own regression at line 128 asserts 'ascending amount'.
